'''Garrthinius''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Steniplis sector/Legends|Steniplis sector]] that was under the control of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. Although the population was largely sympathetic to anti-Imperial activity, the insurgents' efforts to resist Imperial occupation were disorganized. Several [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] agents traveled to the planet, where they eventually turned the various revolutionary groups into a force capable of overthrowing the Imperial government.

==Description==
Garrthinius was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Bakura Sourcebook" /> in the [[Garrthinius system/Legends|Garrthinius system]],<ref name="TEA" /> which was located in the [[Steniplis sector/Legends|Steniplis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="TEA Online" /> in the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]].<ref name="Western Reaches" />

==History==
By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]<ref name="Bakura Sourcebook" /> of [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="TEA Date">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Garrthinius was ruled by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. At one point, [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] leaked a fake layout plan of the planet's [[Imperial garrison (Garrthinius)|Imperial garrison]] in an attempt to trap any anti-Imperial insurgents trying to break into the facility. In the [[Standard month/Legends|month]] between the Battle of Endor and the [[Declaration of a New Republic/Legends|founding]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], Garrthinius's Imperial government declared martial law.<ref name="Bakura Sourcebook" />

{{RPGseed}}
At some point during that month-long interval, capitalizing on the disorganized state of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] in the wake of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Death/Legends|death]] at the Battle of Endor, the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] dispatched a team of operatives to Garrthinius to organize the planet's revolutionary groups into a coherent Rebel network capable of agitating the ruling Imperials. The Rebel team's contact was murdered by Imperial Intelligence agent [[Tyric (Imperial)|Tyric]], who had infiltrated the group. He then impersonated the contact and pretended to aid in the Rebel agents' mission.<ref name="Bakura Sourcebook" />

During the Alliance's efforts to rescue several leaders of Garrthinius's insurgent groups, who had been arrested and [[Detention area|detained]] at the Imperial garrison, Tyric accidentally exposed his knowledge of the facility despite the Rebel team using the leaked fake layout plan and thus revealed himself as an Imperial [[Spy/Legends|spy]]. After successfully defeating Tyric and rescuing the leaders, the Alliance operatives united the revolutionary groups and overthrew the Imperial occupation.<ref name="Bakura Sourcebook" />
{{Endgame}}

==Inhabitants==
The population of Garrthinius was rife with anti-Imperial sentiment, and the planet was home to multiple disunited revolutionary groups that resisted the Empire. The anti-Imperial sentiment of the planet also resulted in a strong Imperial Intelligence presence, with Imperial Intelligence agents, such as Tyric, infiltrating some of the resistance groups.<ref name="Bakura Sourcebook" />

==Locations==
An Imperial garrison of a modular design was located on Garrthinius. The make of the facility was so unusual that Imperial Intelligence was able to utilize the building as a trap for Rebel Alliance agents by leaking a fake layout plan depicting a standard [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]].<ref name="Bakura Sourcebook" />

==Behind the scenes==
Garrthinius was mentioned in ''[[The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] guide authored by [[Kathy Tyers]] and [[Eric S. Trautmann]] and published in [[1996]] by [[West End Games]] for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. In the book, the planet is used in an adventure seed as the location of a Rebel Alliance mission; this article assumes the scenario plays out as described.<ref name="Bakura Sourcebook" /> ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a reference book published in [[2009]], placed the Garrthinius [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the planet itself, in grid square M-18.<ref name="TEA" />
